mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, we are looking at clear skies and 60 degrees out near Badger Prairie County Park, with the first quarter moon visible.

For city updates, you can tune into the VHAT government and public access channel on Spectrum or TDS. Also, remember that you can drop off organic food waste for free at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop if you register for a lock combination.

Today is a busy day in Verona, featuring the Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, you can catch a live concert at Century School Park or join in for Hop Haus trivia.
In our weekly report, on July 13th, officers responded to a call where a 36-year-old man was arrested for an O-W-I after his vehicle became stuck on a large rock.
Today's flavor of the day is Mint Explosion. The store is currently closed, but they will be opening their doors at 10:00 AM. If you miss out today, tomorrow's flavor will be Really Reese's.
